notes: Read all three units, full environmental context, all eight candidates and the review. Named Clear Skies in the regulatory-certainty claim and attached the final predicted outcomes to the combined Clear Skies measures and separate diesel-pollution reduction. Restored the omitted linkage between private-property security and the environmental agenda and the source's generalization about people who live, work and own land.

claims.claim_text: The platform links private-property security to its environmental agenda because it says environmental stewardship advances best where property is privately held.
People who live on, work and own land are characterized as loving and protecting it.
President Bush's Clear Skies plan would provide regulatory certainty enabling power plants to install state-of-the-art pollution controls.

Clear Skies' cap-and-trade and market-based measures, together with a 90 percent diesel-vehicle pollution cut, would significantly improve the environment while preserving reliable affordable electricity and a strong U.S. coal industry.
